verses.text: Ixlajwi juntzanh chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Abram icha t'a wayichal, ix yalan icha tik: --Ach Abram manh ach xiwok, a in ol ach in kolo', te niwan spak ol wak' t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Abram icha tik: --Ach Jehová Wajalil, ¿tas wal yopisio jun spak chi' wu'uj? Ojtak wal to malaj junok wuninal ix ak'a' yik hata' swak'xikan jantak tas ay t'ayin, yuj chi' a junok in chekab' ol cha'ankan masanil tas ay t'ayin, haton winhaj Eliezer aj Damasco, a winh sat yaj t'a heb' in chekab' smasanil, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh: --Ma'ay, ha t'a junok uninal ol kanok, manhoklaj t'a winh komon anima chi' ol kanok, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jielta winh yuj Dios t'a sti' smantiado, ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: --K'e'anh k'elan t'a satcha'anh. B'isto juntzanh k'anal chi' naik, tato syal a b'isani. Ichaton chi' ol aj sb'isul heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yak'och winhaj Abram chi' t'a sk'o'ol tas ix yal Jehová chi', yuj chi' wach' ix kan winh t'a yichanh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: --Ha in ton Jehová in ach wik'elta t'a chonhab' Ur t'a yol yik Caldea yik swak' jun lu'um tik t'ayach yik tzikej, xchi t'a winh.
--Palta ach Jehová Wajalil, ¿tas wal tz'aj wojtakaneli tato swikejkan jun lu'um tik? xchi winhaj Abram chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová: --Ik'kot junok nok' kob'es wakax t'ayin yet' junok nok' chiwa yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, oxe' ab'il sk'inal junjun nok'. Tzik'anpaxkot junok nok' kuwajte' yet' junok nok' paramuch, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yik'kankot juntzanh nok' nok' chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix lajwi chi' ix schapojan snanhal junjun nok' winh. Jilip nok' ix kan t'a stz'ey jilipxo nok'. Haxo nok' much chi', maj schapojejlaj snanhal nok' winh.
Tz'em nok' ostok t'a yib'anh nok', haxo winhaj Abram chi' spechan nok'.
Ayik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix te sat sk'ol winhaj Abram chi' swayi, ix ja jun niwan xiwelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj jun niwan k'ik' k'inal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: --Yowalil tzojtakejeli to a heb' inhtilal, ol b'atkan kajan heb' t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ochkan heb' chekab'ok, chanhe' ciento ab'il ol ixtaj heb'.
Palta a in ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'ok chi'. Slajwi chi', ol elta heb' yet' jantak sb'eyumal.
Palta a ach tik junk'olal ol aj a chami ayik ol ach och icham winakil.
Chanh makanhxo inhtilal ix ek'i, ichato chi' ol meltzajxikot heb' t'a tik, yujto manto tz'akwok schukal heb' amorreo t'a tik, xchi Jehová.
Ayik t'ak'walilxo, ix sch'oxan sb'a jun k'ak' kulkon sk'e'i, b'akaki sk'e stab'il. Tz'ek' t'a skal nok' nok' chapoj yaj chi'.

Haton t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix sb'o strato Jehová yet' winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan icha tik: --Ha jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' inhtilal, schakot lum t'a jun smelemal ha' t'a yik Egipto, masanto t'a ha' Éufrates,
haton slu'um heb' ceneo, heb' cenezeo, heb' cadmoneo,
heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' refaíta,
heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' gergeseo yet' heb' jebuseo, xchi t'a winh.
